ball.q: Which manager sat his Hull City players down on the pitch for a half-time dressing down at Manchester City on Boxing Day 2008?
ball.sub: Hull were 4-0 down and he said their 4,000 travelling fans deserved an explanation.

ball.q: Which Norwich City co-owner took a microphone onto the pitch at half-time in 2005 and called out, let's be having you?
ball.sub: Norwich had led Manchester City 2-0 and ended up losing 3-2.

ball.q: Which QPR captain was sent off at Manchester City on the final day of 2011-12 and then kicked and tried to headbutt opponents?
ball.sub: Twelve-match ban. City won 3-2 in stoppage time to take the title.

ball.q: Which club came from 3-0 down in the closing minutes to draw 3-3 with Liverpool in May 2014?
ball.sub: Liverpool were trying to eat into Manchester City's goal difference. City took the title.

ball.q: Which Hull City midfielder celebrated a goal at Manchester City in 2009 by copying Phil Brown's on-pitch team talk?
Whose agent complained in 2014 that Manchester City had not made enough of the player's birthday?
ball.sub: The club had given him a cake.

ball.q: Which striker ran the length of the pitch to celebrate in front of the Arsenal fans after scoring for Manchester City in September 2009?
ball.sub: City won 4-2 and he was later banned for three games for violent conduct.

ball.q: Which Belgian club did Vincent Kompany captain before joining Hamburg and then Manchester City?
Which former Manchester City captain started 2019-20 as Anderlecht's player-manager, then handed over the touchline weeks later?
Which former Manchester City forward ruptured his Achilles on his KV Kortrijk debut in August 2023?
ball.sub: He had signed from Oostende five days earlier.

ball.q: Which club from a small town near Poznań knocked Hertha Berlin and Manchester City out of the 2003-04 UEFA Cup?
ball.sub: In 2008 Polonia Warsaw took over its top-flight place.

ball.q: Toronto FC named Ryan Nelsen head coach in January 2013. What was odd about it?
ball.a: He was still a Queens Park Rangers player
ball.sub: He played one more Premier League game, a 0-0 with Manchester City, before flying out.

ball.q: Frank Lampard was unveiled by NYCFC in 2014 but played for Manchester City instead. What did the crowd chant at the 2015 SuperDraft?
Crystal Palace won the 2026 Conference League a year after their first major trophy. Which competition was that?
ball.sub: They beat Manchester City in the 2025 final.
